Reasoning: When doing AC small-signal analysis, VDD and all DC grounds are regarded as AC ground. Let go1=1/r01, go2=1/r02. At the Vout node, the output resistance of M2 gives the conductance go2 to AC ground, and the output resistance of M1 gives the conductance go1 to AC ground. Since the gate and lower terminal of M1 are AC ground, its small-signal transconductance action is equivalent to a conductance gm1 from Vout to ground. M2 is controlled by the gate input Vin, and produces a controlled current at the Vout node proportional to gm2 Vin; taking the sign according to the common-source direction in the figure, write the KCL for currents leaving the Vout node: (gm1 + go1 + go2)Vout + gm2 Vin = 0. Therefore Vout/Vin = -gm2/(gm1 + go1 + go2). Substituting go1=1/r01 and go2=1/r02, and writing it in parallel-resistance form, the gain obtained is -gm2(1/gm1 || r01 || r02).

method.method_draft: First describe the image topology, then form the AC small-signal circuit. Set VDD and all drawn grounds to AC ground. At Vout, include conductance go2=1/r02 from M2 to AC ground, conductance go1=1/r01 from M1 to AC ground, and the small-signal transconductance path of M1 that appears as a conductance gm1 from Vout to ground because M1 has its gate and lower terminal at AC ground. The M2 gate signal Vin produces a controlled output current proportional to gm2 Vin at the Vout node. Write KCL at Vout with currents leaving the node: (gm1+go1+go2)Vout + gm2 Vin = 0, using the sign set by the M2 common-source orientation in the drawing. Solve for Vout/Vin = -gm2/(gm1+go1+go2), then rewrite the denominator as a parallel resistance to get -gm2(1/gm1 || r01 || r02).

method.method_draft: First identify the visual structure as an upper input transistor M2 driving the output node and a lower gate-grounded transistor M1 loading that same node. In AC, VDD is ground, so M2 contributes an output resistance r02 from Vout to ground and acts as a controlled current source of magnitude gm2 Vin feeding the output node with the common-source sign inversion. The lower device M1, with its gate grounded and lower terminal grounded in the drawing, presents a small-signal resistance at Vout equal to approximately 1/gm1 in parallel with r01. Therefore the total small-signal resistance seen at Vout is Rout = 1/gm1 || r01 || r02. Apply the transconductance-stage relation Av = -gm2 Rout to obtain -gm2(1/gm1 || r01 || r02).
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：电路图中，上方晶体管标为 M2，其上端接 VDD，栅极由左侧 Vin 驱动；M2 下端与下方晶体管 M1 的上端相连，该中间节点向右引出并标为 Vout。下方晶体管 M1 的栅极接地，底端也接地。推理：做 AC 小信号分析时，VDD 为交流地。上方 M2 对输出节点提供输出电阻 r02 到交流地，并由输入 Vin 产生受控电流，形成共源反相作用，等效跨导为 gm2。下方 M1 的栅极和下端均为交流地，因此从 Vout 看入 M1 的小信号等效电阻为 1/gm1 与 r01 并联。输出节点总等效电阻为 Rout = 1/gm1 ∥ r01 ∥ r02。因此电压增益为 Av = ∂Vout/∂Vin = -gm2 Rout = -gm2(1/gm1 ∥ r01 ∥ r02)。
